log_level.description: Logging verbosity level (e.g., debug, info, warning, error).

log_file.description: Path to the PCRF log file.

db_host.description: Hostname or IP of the MongoDB server.

s5s8_gtpc_local_address.description: Local IP address for S5/S8 GTP-C interface binding.

s5s8_gtpc_peers.description: List of S-GW or P-GW peers for S5/S8 GTP-C.

hostname.description: Optional hostname for the peer (used for logging).

s6a_local_address.description: Local IP address for S6a SCTP interface binding.

s6a_peers.description: List of MME peers for S6a interface.

ip.description: IP address of the MME peer.

hostname.description: Optional hostname for the peer (used for logging).

gx_local_address.description: Local IP address for Gx (Diameter) interface binding.

gx_peers.description: List of P-GW peers for Gx interface.

ip.description: IP address of the P-GW peer.

gy_local_address.description: Local IP address for Gy (Diameter) interface binding.

gy_peers.description: List of OCS (Online Charging Server) peers for Gy interface.

ip.description: IP address of the OCS peer.

charging_offline_enabled.description: Enable offline charging (CDR generation to file).

charging_offline_file_path.description: Path prefix for offline charging record files.

charging_online_enabled.description: Enable online charging (real-time credit control with OCS via Gy).

charging_online_servers.description: List of OCS servers for online charging (Gy).

host.description: Host IP or hostname of the OCS server.

session_max_sessions_per_ue.description: Maximum number of EPS bearers/sessions allowed per UE.

session_max_rate_uplink_kbps.description: Default maximum UE aggregate uplink bitrate in kbps (if not overridden by subscription).

session_max_rate_downlink_kbps.description: Default maximum UE aggregate downlink bitrate in kbps.

bearer_qos_enabled.description: Enable QoS enforcement per default bearer (uses ARP in bearer creation).

bearer_qos_default_priority_level.description: Default ARP priority level for bearer establishment (1–15, lower = higher priority).

bearer_qos_preemption_capability.description: Whether this bearer can preempt lower-priority bearers.

bearer_qos_preemption_vulnerability.description: Whether this bearer can be preempted by higher-priority bearers.

default_charging_rules_list.description: List of preconfigured default charging rules (used when OCS is offline or absent).

rating_group.description: Rating group ID for offline charging (must match OCS config if online).

qos_qci.description: QCI value for the default bearer (1–9).

arp_priority_level.description: Allocation and Retention Priority (ARP) priority level.

realtime_billing_enabled.description: Enable real-time billing (enforce online charging where available).

realm.description: Diameter realm used in PCRF identity (must match PLMN).
